Forty of Kevin Trudeau's friends sat in a room with a combined net worth of over $1 trillion. One of them personally controls a $750 billion hedge fund.

Kevin asked them all the same question: how many of you have read Think and Grow Rich, or studied the law of attraction? Almost none of them had.

The one book nearly every one of them had actually read was How to Win Friends and Influence People. Most had taken the full Dale Carnegie course - some companies required it for executives.

Not manifesting. Not visualization. People skills.

Everything works through people. Unless you can connect with someone, nothing else you've learned matters.

#kevintrudeau #richmindset #moneymindset #networking #successhabits #wealthhabits

John D. Rockefeller became the richest man who ever lived - worth close to $1 trillion in today's money, mostly in cash, unlike Elon Musk, Bill Gates or Jeff Bezos, whose fortunes are mostly stock.

Kevin Trudeau points out where it started: Rockefeller's first job was selling newspapers. His very first paycheck was $1.50.

He gave 30% of it away. Not after he got rich - before. From the very first dollar he ever earned.

Most people plan to start giving once they've 'made it.' Rockefeller did it backwards, and backwards is how he became Rockefeller.

What would 30% of your next paycheck actually cost you?

#kevintrudeau #rockefeller #moneymindset #richmindset #wealthhabits #successhabits

Kevin Trudeau was about to drop $430,000 on a new Maybach - right next to the parking garage where it would've sat was a homeless shelter he'd never noticed before.

He test-drove it, loved it, had the cash sitting in his safe. Then he went for a walk around the block to think it over. It was freezing. He was wrapped in cashmere and a silk scarf. The men at the shelter had no coats at all.

Halfway around the block, it hit him: this wasn't a coincidence. He walked back in and funded the shelter instead - coats, boots, socks, food, no name attached, no mention of it for decades.

Weeks later he'd pass men on the street wearing his coats and never say a word.
